name: Olivia Hayes
bio:
Olivia's journey into motorsport was somewhat unconventional, beginning with a fascination for organizational psychology and a chance internship at a local racing team. She quickly recognized the unique challenges and rewards of managing talent in such a high-pressure environment. Her passion for creating a supportive and efficient team dynamic led her to pursue a career in HR, specifically within the motorsport industry.

At Porsche Penske Motorsport, Olivia is responsible for attracting, developing, and retaining top talent across various departments. She believes in fostering a culture of continuous improvement, where employees are empowered to contribute their best work. Olivia is known for her proactive approach to conflict resolution and her ability to build strong relationships with team members at all levels.

What sets Olivia apart is her commitment to data-driven decision-making in HR. She constantly analyzes performance metrics and employee feedback to identify areas for improvement and implement innovative strategies to enhance team morale and productivity.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often styled in a high ponytail during race weekends
physical.description: Olivia is of average height with a slender build and a constantly alert expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with employee feedback and HR strategy ideas.
Has a habit of starting team meetings with an inspirational quote related to teamwork or performance.
Secretly collects miniature race cars and displays them in her office.
